resolved_findings.summary: Advisory candidate discovery is no longer claimed to be serialized at commit.
resolved_findings.evidence: The plan now limits complete-candidate drift detection to mutation preflight, explicitly permits post-preflight unselected Event drift, and confines the atomic guarantee to exact Observation facts and selected confounders.

resolved_findings.summary: The review revision has a defined untrusted-coordinate and tamper model.
resolved_findings.evidence: The plan specifies a server-recomputed canonical SHA-256 digest over project, Plan, Action version, Observation hash, discovery state and sorted complete candidate IDs. It is neither parsed browser data nor authorization, with malformed, substituted, cross-coordinate and stale tests required.

do_not_change: Retain the generic finalizer's one-time Observation-race retry for non-human callers.
Retain the writer's existing atomic exact-Observation and selected-confounder protections.
